subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-10-09
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 9, 2026

~15 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this period (10/1→10/9), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 15 straight weeks flat.

Traffic vs last week

No change. SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, same as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No. All 49 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 49/49 all-time, zero failures (2 more clean runs since the last pulse — Thursday's 2026-10-08 on-page/schema fix session shipped cleanly). Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10. AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this remains a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all. catalog.ts's 9 gated connectors (all past their own ETAs) are byte-for-byte unchanged. In the destinations catalog, power_bi, excel, and snowflake stay past due, and shareable_dashboard's \"October 2026\" ETA — the one entry due this very month — still hasn't flipped from coming_soon with the month now a third gone. Worth a closer check at the next pulse or two.

Reading the week

A genuinely quiet pulse layered on top of a non-quiet week: Thursday's session (2026-10-08) found and fixed a real site-wide bug outside the usual keyword/catalog sweep — four live static pages and the shared page template had been shipping another page's Open Graph/Twitter cards and JSON-LD (a stale clone-and-forget artifact), and all 5 comparison pages were emitting a duplicate, conflicting WebPage schema block. Both are now fixed and shipped. Since then, the numbers this pulse exists to track haven't moved: rank flat at the not-ranked floor across all 22 tracked terms for a 15th straight week, backlinks flat 3/2, AI Result Tracker still unconfigured. That continues to read as a brand-new domain (DA 0) inside Google's normal indexing/trust ramp, not a content or technical problem — this week's on-page find is evidence the technical/content side keeps getting real, if small, defects shaken out even after months of 'exhausted' verdicts. The two items still worth a human's 30 minutes, unchanged from every recent pulse: (1) GSC sitemap submission, still not done since Week 1 of the original plan; (2) off-page Phase 1, still 0 of 6 free directory listings. Both remain the cheapest, most leveraged open items on the entire plan, and neither can be done from this sandbox.
